bugs.title: New mission creation vs dispatching work into an existing mission is unclear
Orca/Windows notifications expose raw internal run IDs and are noisy
Authorization can repeatedly trigger on negated consequential language (e.g. "do not merge/push/deploy") and may fail to consume explicit approval once
evidence: Directly related to (but distinct surface from) the negation/authorization-loop work already fixed for Command's project-targeting resolver in tsf-command-authority-repair-v1 (chat-responder.mjs's isConsequentialDirective/PROHIBITION_MARKERS clause-level negation already exists and is adversarial-review-hardened for TIM_REQUIRED classification specifically) -- this bug is about the operator-facing UI authorization/approval-consumption flow, not yet reproduced in that context. Worth checking whether the same clause-level negation logic is (or isn't) actually reaching the surface Tim observed this on before assuming a fresh fix is needed.

bugs.title: Excessive internal orchestration terminology is exposed to the operator
Run-now forms use disappearing placeholders instead of persistent labels/help text and provide insufficient space to review scope/spec content
A stalled mission can display CONTINUE as non-interactive text instead of a usable control
Active Work cards can deep-link to generic project Overview instead of the exact mission/run
Planner Chat can be blind to durable state visible in Keep Going / Flight Recorder
No trustworthy persistent global surface showing RUNNING / PAUSED / WAITING / STALLED / VERIFYING / NEEDS YOU / READY FOR ADOPTION
evidence: This is the P0 canonical-state item: one shared runtime state read by Planner Chat, Work, Keep Going, Flight Recorder, Home, Fleet, and notifications. Likely the root dependency several other bugs (05, 12, 13) sit on top of -- candidate for first real implementation wave.

bugs.title: Stalled-run recovery lacks clear reason, heartbeat, worker/provider, retries, and Resume / Retry / Replan / Abandon actions

acceptance.title: User requests a new governed mission through Planner Chat
